## Popular Books in the Last Decade

### Problem Description

Consider the following table:

Table - Books

| book_id | title | date | sales |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Mockingjay | 2010-01-01 | 200000 |
| 2 | Ready Player One | 2011-05-12 | 1500000 |
| 3 | The Hate U Give | 2017-06-09 | 1200000 |
| 4 | Life After Life | 2013-10-12 | 50000 |
| 5 | Lord of the Rings | 1954-05-17 | 150000000 |
| 6 | Atonement | 2001-02-23 | 1000000 |

Task: Retrieve the titles and the sale numbers of books published in the last decade (2010 - 2019) that have sold more than 1 million copies.

Expected Output

| title | sales |
| --- | --- |
| Ready Player One | 1500000 |
| The Hate U Give | 1200000 |
